stage.name: Myriapoda-3
stage.description: The battlefield is even narrower. It's recommended to upgrade Operators to get through it.

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

rioter_leader.name: Rioter Leader
rioter_leader.flavourText: An enemy combatant of unknown identity, more dangerous than a normal Thug. They are often found wherever there is turmoil and unrest. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity and use haphazardly-made weapons to engage in melee combat. These weapons are usually associated with riots.

arts_guard.name: Arts Guard
arts_guard.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who has also been trained in using Originium Arts. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with armor-ignoring Arts damage. Reunion's frontline squads have become a lot more devastating since the inclusion of these soldiers.

crossbowman_leader.name: Crossbowman Leader
crossbowman_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's senior ranged soldiers, more powerful than a normal Crossbowman. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they wear masks to conceal their identities during operations.

bladed_fighter.name: Bladed Fighter
bladed_fighter.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers who has been trained in traditional martial arts. Equipped with refitted fist weapons, they are capable of inflicting massive damage with their rapid strikes.

heavy_defender_leader.name: Heavy Defender Leader
heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Heavy Defender. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.
